title: Tier Entry Requirements and Compliance Retention Coverage — Continuum Backup & Recovery
content:
Each Continuum Backup & Recovery tier has an entry gate: a minimum number of protected items at order, on some tiers a minimum number of servers, and a set of compliance frameworks whose retention requirement the tier meets. The framework that counts is the compliance framework declared on the client's profile.

## Entry gate by tier

| Tier | Minimum protected items at order | Minimum servers | Frameworks whose retention the tier meets | Frameworks excluded at entry |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | 1 | none set | none declared; PCI DSS | HIPAA; CMMC Level 2; FINRA-SEC |
| Continuum Backup Standard | 1 | none set | none declared; PCI DSS; HIPAA; CMMC Level 2 | FINRA-SEC |
| Continuum Backup Plus | 3 | none set | none declared; PCI DSS; HIPAA; CMMC Level 2 | none listed |
| Continuum BDR | 3 | 1 | none declared; PCI DSS; HIPAA; CMMC Level 2 | none listed |
| Continuum DRaaS | 5 | 2 | none declared; PCI DSS; HIPAA; CMMC Level 2; FINRA-SEC | none |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | 10 | 3 | none declared; PCI DSS; HIPAA; CMMC Level 2; FINRA-SEC | none |

"None declared" stands for a client profile that declares no compliance framework. Protected items are servers, workstations and Microsoft 365 users together.

On Continuum Backup Plus and Continuum BDR the entry gate lists no excluded framework, and FINRA-SEC is likewise not among the frameworks whose retention those tiers meet.

## Points of judgement

- **Counting items.** The minimum is a count of all protected items of every class. For example, a hypothetical order of two servers and one workstation is three protected items, which reaches the minimum of 3 on Continuum Backup Plus; two items in total would fall one short.
- **Counting servers.** Where a minimum number of servers is set, only servers count toward it. A hypothetical order of one server and twenty workstations meets the item minimum of Continuum DRaaS but not its minimum of 2 servers.
- **Framework coverage.** A tier meets a framework only where the framework appears in that tier's list above. A client whose profile declares FINRA-SEC is met only by Continuum DRaaS and Continuum DRaaS Premier; a client declaring HIPAA or CMMC Level 2 is met by every tier except Continuum Backup Basic; a client declaring PCI DSS, or declaring none, is met by every tier.
